# Third-party material in the visualize skill

- `SKILL.md`, section "Design discipline": adapted from the `frontend-design` skill in
  https://github.com/anthropics/skills (skills/frontend-design, commit 41bbe19), licensed under the
  Apache License 2.0 (`anthropic-skills-LICENSE.txt`). Changes: condensed and rewritten for
  research views (type scale, line length, template tells, self-critique).
- The chart-selection table follows common data-visualization practice (also summarised in
  inference-sh/skills `data-visualization` and bytedance/deer-flow `chart-visualization`); no text
  or code was copied from those repositories.
- `.opencode/artifact-kit/chart.umd.min.js`: Chart.js 4.4.1, MIT (see `artifact-kit/kit.json`).
